summary: Bandai Namco's Wii resort-sports line, beginning with Balance Board skiing, expanding into skiing and snowboarding, then broadening into the multi-resort Go Vacation.

entries.title: We Ski

emulation.notes: Use Wii hardware for Balance Board authenticity; Dolphin can preserve the base game, with peripheral support depending on setup.

primary.why: We Ski released for Wii in 2008 and was the first third-party Wii game to use the Wii Balance Board. Wii is the only platform and therefore the complete route, though WiiConnect24 photo-sharing features are no longer available.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii or Wii U with Wii Remote and Nunchuk; add the Wii Balance Board for the intended control option.

all_releases.fidelity: Only release; Wii skiing game with optional Balance Board support.
all_releases.reason: primary: sole released platform and complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Wii is the sole platform, so there is no cross-platform conflict.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; WiiConnect24 photo-sharing support was discontinued by Nintendo in 2013.

entries.title: We Ski & Snowboard

emulation.notes: Use Wii hardware for Balance Board authenticity; Dolphin can preserve the base game, with peripheral support depending on setup.

primary.why: We Ski & Snowboard is the Wii sequel to We Ski, adding snowboarding, two resort areas, Balance Board support, and free-roam resort play. Wii is the only released platform and therefore the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Wii or Wii U with Wii Remote and Nunchuk; use the Wii Balance Board for the intended skiing/snowboarding option.

all_releases.fidelity: Only release; Wii skiing/snowboarding sequel with optional Balance Board support.
all_releases.reason: primary: sole released platform and complete version.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Wii is the sole platform, so there is no cross-platform conflict.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced remaster; WiiConnect24 photo-sharing support was discontinued by Nintendo in 2013.
